function.arguments: {"finding_id": 3, "resolution": "The treatment arm is systematically associated with higher baseline severity, as shown by the imbalance in severity distribution: the treatment arm has a much higher proportion of severe cases (37.6%) compared to the control arm (4.1%). Since severity is a strong predictor of response, a raw comparison of response rates between arms would confound treatment effect with baseline severity. To obtain a valid estimate of the treatment effect, we used direct standardisation (stratified standardisation) to adjust for severity. The adjusted effect is the correct estimate of the treatment effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
